effectSummary.ko: 1초 보행 후 다음 유료 스킬의 비용이 25% 감소합니다. 사용 후 대기시간은 4초입니다.
effectSummary.en: After walking for 1 second the next skill that costs resource is 25% cheaper. The effect then waits 4 seconds.

productionConcept: An enduring resource economy emblem: a closed leather focus pouch with one amber ember nested beneath a curved feather, and a subtle boot-tread notch on the clasp. Compact and calm, conserving focus while walking, no coins or numbers.
